text:
maya: Heads-up team: client Orbital spotted ~210k extra embedding tokens on Apr 12 invoice, no traffic change on their end. Can eng take a quick look?
liam: On it. Any sample ids?
maya: Put a few in the ticket: OBL_775, OBL_778 around 2029-04-12T09:15Z.
asif: Quick grep: same idempotency_key present but different processing_shard values and duplicated billing rows after a handoff between workers. Looks like a multiprocess handoff re-ingested the same batch.
liam: grep snippet: ```sql
SELECT idempotency_key, count(*) FROM embedding_events WHERE idempotency_key IN ('id-OBL-775') GROUP BY idempotency_key; -- returns 2
```
kevin: If ingestion duplicated at handoff, billing dedupe keys might miss because ledger uses (request_id, vector_hash). We should add idempotency_key into the ledger dedupe key.
maya: Estimate impact? Finance needs numbers to approve credits.
liam: Running quick aggregate: ~213,450 duplicate tokens in the 09:10-09:20 window.
kevin: At Orbital rate $0.00014/token that's ~$29.88. Finance, can we pre-approve this one-off credit pending backfill?
finance-bot: Auto-check: dedupe-exception-rate for Orbital in window = 0.6% (>0.5%). Backfill job BF-2029-912 created (dry-run queued).
asif: Remediation: 1) add idempotency_key to billing dedupe; 2) add worker handoff guard to avoid double-acking batches; 3) run backfill dry-run and then ledger adjustments.
liam: Patch `billing/include-idempotency` ready, will canary this afternoon. Backfill dry-run shows matching 213,450 dup tokens. CSV uploaded to ticket.
maya: Approved. Kevin, please schedule ledger adj memo "dedupe-backfill: worker-handoff duplicate (Apr 12)" and notify Orbital after posting.
kevin: Will do. Also adding a dashboard metric for "handoff_duplicate_rate" to catch regressions.
maya: Thanks all. Closing after ledger post.
